column1: # libnei benchmark manifest — one bench per line, shared by the Windows (run_all_benches.ps1)
# and POSIX (run_all_benches.sh) runners so both platforms measure the same set with the same
#   name   : base name of the log file (logs/<name>.log) and the section title in report.md
#   exe    : bench executable (the runner appends .exe on Windows)
#   rounds : number of repetitions appended to the same log file
#   args   : space separated, may be empty; {tmp} expands to a per-run scratch directory
#            (used by the log benches, which write their output files there)
# Keep the multi-round entries first: they are the ones with a documented methodology
# (mean over N rounds), and the single-round ones are only useful as smoke/trend signals.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
